description: The Digitales Landschaftsmodell 1:250 000 (DLM250) of the Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie (BKG) describes Germany's topographic objects and relief as vector data, following the ATKIS object catalogue (version 7.1.2). Contents: object types with their main attributes, organised in layers for settlements and buildings, transport (roads with road class and number, railways, waterways, airports and ports), vegetation, water bodies, relief and administrative areas, including facilities of supply and disposal such as power lines where captured at this scale; an INSPIRE edition maps the road, railway, water and air networks to the INSPIRE Transport Networks model through EuroRegionalMap. Coverage: the Federal Republic of Germany at a 1:250,000 reference scale; the data were updated to 31 December 2024 (release note of 14 May 2025) with an annual cycle. Format and access: direct download of a zipped Shapefile set in UTM zone 32 (about 300 MB) from the BKG geodata centre, a NAS compact edition, and WFS and WMS download services including INSPIRE services. Licence: Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0 (dl-de/by-2-0), with the source note © GeoBasis-DE / BKG and an explicit permission for OpenStreetMap; free. Caveats: generalised at 1:250,000, so small roads and local networks are missing; the utility objects were not checked layer by layer. Simulation uses: national road, rail and waterway network geometry for hazard exposure and network flow models of Germany. Related records: the federal waterways network of the WSV (data-wsv-germany-verknet-bwastr-federal-waterways-network) gives stationed waterway links.
